scope: Choose how spoken text is cleaned.

topics.title: Choose a dictation type
details: Open Input options. Choose Dictation type. Old school keeps the speech entry you used before. It is the default.
AI-based uses the local AI speech model for stops and capital letters. It also removes um, uh, and clear repeated starts. It works in text, notes, mail, and web text boxes.
This mode works offline. It needs no account or extra fee. It does not send your voice or text to a new online service.

topics.title: Keep control of your words
details: Commands and typed text keep their normal role. Say Type literally to keep words as spoken. You can still use Undo in text and mail.
Cleanup is light. It does not fix every stumble or guess missing words. It keeps grammar as spoken. Read your text to check it.
The app uses the speech model it has already loaded. There is no second AI request. Text still waits for a pause. Speed depends on the PC. Live speech speed has not been measured on your PC.
